text:
maria: Overnight sweeper job failed at ~03:05 UTC, lots of 403s when deleting old model artifacts. job=sweeper-2026-03-17-03

chris: saw that, alert fired. looks like the sa-sweeper role lost s3:DeleteObject perms for the bucket. stackdriver shows 403s starting 03:02.

alex: adding logs:
```
2026-03-17T03:02:11Z ERROR sweeper.go:142 deleteObject: AccessDenied: Access Denied
	status code: 403, request id: 7E8F...
```

maria: thanks. any recent infra changes? iam audit maybe? @infra-bot can you pull iam diff for sa-sweeper in the last 24h? :eyes:

infra-bot: IAM diff (sa-sweeper):
- policy change by infra/jenkins (2026-03-17T01:48Z)
  - removed s3:DeleteObject from arn:aws:s3:::redwood-model-artifacts/*
  - added condition `StringEquals: {aws:RequestedRegion: eu-west-1}`
(see https://infra.redwood.com/changes/CH-4829)

sam: that condition would cause deletes to fail in us-west-2 where the job runs. looks like a bad merge from the cross-region hardening PR. cc @tanya who approved?

tanya: I approved the PR but I thought deletes were scoped to eu. my bad — I missed the cross-region effect.

maria: plan: 1) revert the IAM change, 2) rerun sweeper in dry-run then live, 3) backfill any artifacts that weren't cleaned. who can revert?

chris: I can revert the change, opening a revert CL now and will request quick review.

alex: while revert lands, can we run a manual dry-run that only lists targets (no deletes) to estimate backlog? `./tools/sweeper --dry-run --limit 1000`

maria: yes please run dry-run and post a sample (first 20 keys). we'll confirm no user data affected.

chris: revert CL created: https://infra.redwood.com/cl/4872 (revert of CH-4829). tagging @tanya for fast approve.

tanya: approved, leaving a note to infra on safe rollback. :white_check_mark:

infra-bot: Revert CL merged at 03:38 UTC. IAM should propagate in ~2-5 min.

alex: ran dry-run at 03:46 UTC, sample output (20 keys):
```
models/old/v1/checkpoint-20210101.tar.gz
models/legacy/bert-small/ckpt-2019-06-04/...
models/tmp/unreferenced-abcdef.tar.gz
... (total 12,345 candidates)
```

sam: estimate ~5k deletes for us-west-2. that's ~30s/object with current rate-limiter -> ~42 hours if serial. need batching + parallel deletes.

maria: for backfill we should: run sweeper with parallelism=50 and throttle so we don't spike S3 API. open a short maintenance window and notify customers of potential rate noise.

chris: creating a scheduled run: `kubectl -n batch run sweeper-manual --image=... --env="PARALLEL=50" --command -- ./tools/sweeper --delete --limit 5000` will run at 04:15 UTC after propagation.

tanya: is there any chance we hit billing or request limit? ops? :thinking_face:

alex: I'll watch CloudWatch for 5xx/errors, set an alarm on 503 rate > 5% in 1m. also will pause if we see >1000 503s/min.

maria: assign follow-ups: chris -> incident/rollback CL (done), alex -> monitoring + run, sam -> post-run verification script (checksum + reference list), tanya -> postmortem write-up and client notify if needed.

chris: started manual run at 04:17 UTC. first 200 deletes succeeded, rate stable.

maria: thanks. if any failures, paste error snippet. and please add a canary to the sweeper to verify IAM perms before deletes in future.

sam: post-run verification shows 4,892 deletions succeeded, 108 failed (transient 503). I'm requeuing failed keys with exponential backoff.

alex: alarms stayed under threshold, RPS peaked at 45% of quota. good. :thumbsup:

tanya: adding canary check ticket: https://tickets.redwood.com/TKT-9923 and will include a pre-delete IAM check in the job.

maria: great. closing thread — postmortem draft request assigned to tanya, due EOD tomorrow. thanks all. :rocket:
